intro: Reading short instructions and recognising the action, warning and condition they express.
p.etiqueta.consejo: The qu sounds k: e-ti-KE-ta. It usually gives the name, size or instructions.
p.instrucciones.consejo: It is almost always plural. «Leer las instrucciones» is the first step with a new device.
p.aviso.consejo: It comes from «avisar». An aviso can be a sign or a message.
p.aparato.consejo: You say «un aparato de cocina» or «un aparato eléctrico». It is masculine.
p.cable.consejo: It is masculine: «el cable». It plugs into the wall.
p.desenchufe.consejo: It is the opposite of «enchufe». -ar verbs end in -e with usted.
p.desenchufo.consejo: It is «desenchufar» in yo. The prefix des- removes the connection.
p.dañado.consejo: It comes from «daño». The ñ sounds ny: da-NYA-do. It changes: «dañada».
p.prohibido.consejo: The h in the middle is silent: pro-i-BI-do. Signs use it with an infinitive.
p.antes de.consejo: It takes an infinitive: «antes de limpiar». The opposite is «después de».
p.después de.consejo: It also takes an infinitive: «después de comer». The final s is faint.
p.salida de emergencia.consejo: It usually has a green sign with an arrow. It is never blocked.
b1.titulo: Find the action and the condition
b1.texto:
Instructions often use an **usted command**: **Desenchufe** el aparato. A negative command gives a **prohibition**: **No lo use** cerca del agua.

Notice the words that set the order or the condition:

- **antes de** + infinitive: **antes de** limpiarlo.
- **después de** + infinitive: **después de** limpiarlo.
- **si** + present: **si** el cable está dañado, no lo use.

The texts in this lesson are invented practice, not real labels.
b2.f1.texto: Unplug the device before cleaning it.
b2.f2.texto: Do not use it near water.
b2.f5.texto: The cable is in good condition.
b4.titulo: Commands, antes de and después de
b4.texto:
To give an order to **usted** you use the command: **desenchufe**, **use**, **consulte**. To forbid, add **no**: **no use**, **no encienda**.

The pronoun is **attached** to the affirmative command (**déjelo** secar) and **before** the negative (**no lo use**).

To order the steps:

- **antes de** + infinitive: **antes de** limpiar el aparato, desenchúfelo.
- **después de** + infinitive: **después de** limpiarlo, déjelo secar.
b4.e0.texto: Unplug the cable before cleaning the device.
b4.e1.texto: Do not use the device near water.
b5.f0.texto: In a corner of the workshop a very old device rests.
b5.f1.texto: A yellow label hangs from its grey cord.
b5.f2.texto: The small letters have almost faded with the passing of time.
b5.f3.texto: Lucía brings the torch closer and reads each line slowly.
b5.f4.texto: A drop of golden dust falls on the paper.
b5.f5.texto: The label asks for great care with the cord.
b5.f6.texto: A red notice forbids use near water.
b5.f7.texto: Lucía smiles at her grandfather's stern letters.
b5.f8.texto: The grey cord still smells of oil and wood.
b5.f9.texto: She unplugs it from the wall with great care.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It is the first thing, for safety.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Switched on is more dangerous when cleaning.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Wetting it is what the label says not to do.
b6.pregunta: What do you do before cleaning the device?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Well done: it is the usted command of «desenchufar».
b7.o1.refuerzo: Switching on before cleaning is not safe.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Connecting is the opposite of what the label asks.
b8.frase: No lo use cerca del agua
b8.traduccion: Do not use it near water
b9.o0.refuerzo: Exactly! A damaged cord is dangerous.
b9.o1.refuerzo: That is exactly what you must not do.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It is forbidden and even more dangerous.
b9.pregunta: What do you do if the cord is damaged?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «Do not use it near water».
b11.frase: Si el cable está ____, no lo use.
b11.o0.refuerzo: Well done! A damaged cord must not be used.
b11.o1.refuerzo: A clean cord is not dangerous in itself.
b11.o2.refuerzo: A new cord can be used.
b11.pregunta: Which word makes the cord dangerous?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It is the door for danger.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Eating is something else; the sign says nothing about food.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Cleaning goes on another label, not on an exit sign.
p.limpiarlo.consejo: From «limpiar», to clean. The «lo» is stuck to the end.
p.use.consejo: Formal command of «usar», to use. The stress is on U.
p.consulte.consejo: Formal command of «consultar», to consult. The stress is on SUL.
p.fabricante.consejo: The stress falls on KAN. The c sounds like «k».
p.borran.consejo: From «borrar», to erase. The stress is on BO.
p.severas.consejo: Plural of «severo», strict or serious. The stress is on BE.
p.desenchufa.consejo: From «desenchufar», to unplug. The ch sounds like «ch» in «chair».
p.enciendo.consejo: From «encender», to switch on. The c before i sounds like «th».
